#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP "Vintage Story (Stratum + Nimbus)" template.
# Resolves and installs a Stratum release. The release tag pins the Vintage Story
# version (tags look like v1.22.6-stratum.2); Stratum then downloads the matching
# vanilla server assets itself on the next start or during the prepare stage.
set -euo pipefail

root="${1:?root directory required}"
cd "$root"
mkdir -p server

repo="StratumServer/Stratum"
rid="linux-x64"
hdr=(-H "User-Agent: AMP-Stratum-Template" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then hdr+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"); fi

for tool in curl unzip jq; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[AMP] $tool is required but not installed" >&2; exit 1; }
done

tag="$(printf '%s' "${STRATUM_TAG:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] resolving Stratum release (channel=${STRATUM_CHANNEL:-stable} gameVersion=${STRATUM_GAMEVER:-latest})"
  json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=100")"
  filter='.[] | select(.draft == false)'
  if [ "${STRATUM_CHANNEL:-stable}" != "prerelease" ]; then
    filter="${filter} | select(.prerelease == false)"
  fi
  if [ -n "${STRATUM_GAMEVER:-}" ]; then
    filter="${filter} | select(.tag_name | startswith(\"v${STRATUM_GAMEVER}-stratum.\"))"
  fi
  tag="$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r "[ ${filter} ] | .[0].tag_name // empty")"
fi

if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] no Stratum release matched channel=${STRATUM_CHANNEL:-stable} gameVersion=${STRATUM_GAMEVER:-<any>}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

version="${tag#v}"
gamever="${version%%-stratum.*}"
asset="stratum-${version}-${rid}.zip"
marker="server/.amp-stratum-release"

echo "[AMP] Stratum ${version} selected (Vintage Story ${gamever})"

if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(cat "$marker")" = "$tag" ] && [ -x server/StratumServer ]; then
  echo "[AMP] already on ${tag}; nothing to download"
  exit 0
fi

url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}/${asset}"
echo "[AMP] downloading ${url}"
curl -fL --retry 3 -o stratum-release.zip "$url"
unzip -qo stratum-release.zip -d server
rm -f stratum-release.zip
chmod +x server/StratumServer
printf '%s' "$tag" > "$marker"
printf '%s' "$gamever" > server/.amp-stratum-gameversion
echo "[AMP] installed Stratum ${tag} into ${root}server"

# Generated by the AMP "Vintage Story (Stratum + Nimbus)" template.
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Root)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$repo = 'StratumServer/Stratum'
$rid = 'win-x64'
$serverDir = Join-Path $Root 'server'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $serverDir | Out-Null

$headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'AMP-Stratum-Template'; 'Accept' = 'application/vnd.github+json' }
if ($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) { $headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer $($env:GITHUB_TOKEN)" }

if ($env:STRATUM_TAG) { $tag = $env:STRATUM_TAG.Trim() } else { $tag = '' }

if ($tag -eq '') {
    $channel = if ($env:STRATUM_CHANNEL) { $env:STRATUM_CHANNEL } else { 'stable' }
    $gameVer = if ($env:STRATUM_GAMEVER) { $env:STRATUM_GAMEVER.Trim() } else { '' }
    Write-Host "[AMP] resolving Stratum release (channel=$channel gameVersion=$(if ($gameVer) { $gameVer } else { 'latest' }))"
    $releases = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $headers -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases?per_page=100"
    $candidates = @($releases | Where-Object { -not $_.draft })
    if ($channel -ne 'prerelease') { $candidates = @($candidates | Where-Object { -not $_.prerelease }) }
    if ($gameVer -ne '') { $candidates = @($candidates | Where-Object { $_.tag_name.StartsWith("v$gameVer-stratum.") }) }
    if ($candidates.Count -eq 0) { throw "No Stratum release matched channel=$channel gameVersion=$gameVer" }
    $tag = $candidates[0].tag_name
}

$version = $tag.TrimStart('v')
$gamever = ($version -split '-stratum\.')[0]
$asset = "stratum-$version-$rid.zip"
$marker = Join-Path $serverDir '.amp-stratum-release'

Write-Host "[AMP] Stratum $version selected (Vintage Story $gamever)"

if ((Test-Path $marker) -and ((Get-Content $marker -Raw).Trim() -eq $tag) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $serverDir 'StratumServer.exe'))) {
    Write-Host "[AMP] already on $tag; nothing to download"
    exit 0
}

$zip = Join-Path $Root 'stratum-release.zip'
$url = "https://github.com/$repo/releases/download/$tag/$asset"
Write-Host "[AMP] downloading $url"
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $url -OutFile $zip
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $serverDir -Force
Remove-Item $zip -Force
Set-Content -Path $marker -Value $tag -NoNewline
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $serverDir '.amp-stratum-gameversion') -Value $gamever -NoNewline
Write-Host "[AMP] installed Stratum $tag into $serverDir"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP "Vintage Story (Stratum + Nimbus)" template.
# Installs Nimbus.ServerMod into data/Mods so this backend can join a Nimbus network.
set -euo pipefail

root="${1:?root directory required}"
cd "$root"

istrue() { [ "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "true" ]; }
if ! istrue "${NIMBUS_INSTALL:-true}"; then
  echo "[AMP] Nimbus server mod installation is disabled"
  exit 0
fi

repo="StratumServer/Nimbus"
hdr=(-H "User-Agent: AMP-Stratum-Template" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then hdr+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"); fi

for tool in curl unzip jq; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[AMP] $tool is required but not installed" >&2; exit 1; }
done

tag="$(printf '%s' "${NIMBUS_MOD_VERSION:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
  json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=100")"
  filter='.[] | select(.draft == false)'
  if [ "${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable}" != "prerelease" ]; then
    filter="${filter} | select(.prerelease == false)"
  fi
  tag="$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r "[ ${filter} ] | .[0].tag_name // empty")"
fi
[ -n "$tag" ] || { echo "[AMP] no Nimbus release found" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$tag" in v*) ;; *) tag="v${tag}";; esac

mkdir -p data/Mods data/ModConfig
marker="data/Mods/Nimbus.ServerMod/.amp-nimbus-release"
if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(cat "$marker")" = "$tag" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] Nimbus server mod already on ${tag}"
  exit 0
fi

url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}/Nimbus.ServerMod-${tag}.zip"
echo "[AMP] downloading ${url}"
curl -fL --retry 3 -o nimbus-mod.zip "$url"
rm -rf data/Mods/Nimbus.ServerMod
mkdir -p data/Mods/Nimbus.ServerMod
unzip -qo nimbus-mod.zip -d data/Mods/Nimbus.ServerMod
rm -f nimbus-mod.zip
printf '%s' "$tag" > "$marker"
echo "[AMP] installed Nimbus server mod ${tag} into ${root}data/Mods/Nimbus.ServerMod"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP "Vintage Story (Stratum + Nimbus)" template.
# Repairs WorldConfig.SaveFileLocation in data/serverconfig.json before every start.
# Vintage Story stores an absolute path to the .vcdbs world file in that key and never
# recalculates it, so an empty, missing or stale value makes the server abort with
# "Unable to open or create savegame". This script puts a valid path back without
# touching or reformatting any other part of the file.
set -euo pipefail

data="${1:?data directory required}"
data="${data%/}"
cfg="$data/serverconfig.json"

[ -f "$cfg" ] || exit 0

saves="$data/Saves"
desired="$saves/default.vcdbs"
if [ -d "$saves" ] && [ ! -f "$desired" ]; then
  found=""
  count=0
  for f in "$saves"/*.vcdbs; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    found="$f"
    count=$((count + 1))
  done
  if [ "$count" = "1" ]; then
    desired="$found"
  fi
fi

need=0
if ! grep -q '"SaveFileLocation"' "$cfg"; then
  need=2
else
  cur=$(sed -n 's|.*"SaveFileLocation"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\(.*\)".*|\1|p' "$cfg" | head -n 1)
  if [ -z "$cur" ]; then
    need=1
  elif [ ! -d "$(dirname "$cur")" ]; then
    echo "[AMP] serverconfig.json points at $cur but that folder does not exist on this system"
    need=1
  fi
fi

if [ "$need" = "0" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

mkdir -p "$saves"
esc=$(printf '%s' "$desired" | sed -e 's/[\\&|]/\\&/g')

if [ "$need" = "1" ]; then
  sed -i "s|\"SaveFileLocation\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"]*\"|\"SaveFileLocation\": \"$esc\"|" "$cfg"
elif grep -q '"WorldConfig"' "$cfg"; then
  sed -i "s|\"WorldConfig\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*{|&\"SaveFileLocation\": \"$esc\",|" "$cfg"
else
  echo "[AMP] WARNING: no WorldConfig section in $cfg, cannot repair the save file location" >&2
  exit 0
fi

echo "[AMP] repaired SaveFileLocation in serverconfig.json -> $desired"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP "Vintage Story (Stratum + Nimbus)" template.
# Renders data/ModConfig/nimbus-server.json from the instance settings before every start.
# Do not edit: it is overwritten on every update. Set "Let AMP Manage nimbus-server.json"
# to false if you would rather hand-edit the JSON.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?target path required}"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"

istrue() { [ "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "true" ]; }

if ! istrue "${NIMBUS_WRITE_CONFIG:-true}"; then
  echo "[AMP] Nimbus config management is off; leaving $target as it is"
  exit 0
fi

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[AMP] jq is required to render $target but was not found on this system" >&2
  exit 1
fi

port="${NIMBUS_PUBLIC_PORT:-0}"
case "$port" in ''|0|*[!0-9]*) port="${NIMBUS_FALLBACK_PORT:-42420}";; esac
host="${NIMBUS_PUBLIC_HOST:-}"
[ -n "$host" ] || host="127.0.0.1"

bool() { if istrue "${1:-}"; then printf 'true'; else printf 'false'; fi; }

jq -n \
  --arg enabled "$(bool "${NIMBUS_ENABLED:-true}")" \
  --arg id "${NIMBUS_SERVER_ID:-}" \
  --arg dname "${NIMBUS_DISPLAY_NAME:-}" \
  --arg host "$host" \
  --arg port "$port" \
  --arg tags "${NIMBUS_TAGS:-}" \
  --arg regurl "${NIMBUS_REGISTRY_URL:-}" \
  --arg secret "${NIMBUS_SHARED_SECRET:-}" \
  --arg hb "${NIMBUS_HEARTBEAT:-5}" \
  --arg httpto "${NIMBUS_HTTP_TIMEOUT:-5}" \
  --arg maint "$(bool "${NIMBUS_MAINTENANCE:-false}")" \
  --arg resv "$(bool "${NIMBUS_RESERVATION_REQUIRED:-true}")" \
  --arg failclosed "$(bool "${NIMBUS_FAIL_CLOSED:-false}")" \
  --arg allowcmd "$(bool "${NIMBUS_ALLOW_SERVER_COMMAND:-true}")" \
  --arg tmode "${NIMBUS_TRANSFER_MODE:-redirect}" \
  --arg sack "${NIMBUS_SEAMLESS_ACK:-8}" \
  --arg shortcuts "${NIMBUS_SHORTCUTS:-}" \
  '{
     Enabled: ($enabled == "true"),
     ServerId: $id,
     DisplayName: $dname,
     PublicHost: $host,
     PublicPort: ($port | tonumber),
     Tags: ($tags | split(",") | map(gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")) | map(select(length > 0))),
     RegistryUrl: $regurl,
     SharedSecret: $secret,
     HeartbeatIntervalSeconds: ($hb | tonumber),
     RegistryHttpTimeoutSeconds: ($httpto | tonumber),
     Maintenance: ($maint == "true"),
     ReservationRequired: ($resv == "true"),
     FailClosedWhenRegistryUnreachable: ($failclosed == "true"),
     AllowPlayerServerCommand: ($allowcmd == "true"),
     TransferMode: $tmode,
     SeamlessPrepareAckTimeoutSeconds: ($sack | tonumber),
     ShortcutCommands: ($shortcuts | split(";") | map(select(length > 0)) | map(
        (split("@")) as $parts |
        (($parts[0]) | split("=")) as $kv |
        {
          Name: ($kv[0] | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "") | ltrimstr("/")),
          Targets: ((($kv[1]) // "") | split("|") | map(gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")) | map(select(length > 0))),
          Privilege: ((($parts[1]) // "chat") | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")),
          Description: ""
        }) | map(select((.Name | length) > 0 and (.Targets | length) > 0)))
   }' > "$target.amptmp"

mv "$target.amptmp" "$target"
echo "[AMP] wrote $target  serverId=${NIMBUS_SERVER_ID:-<unset>} advertised=${host}:${port} registry=${NIMBUS_REGISTRY_URL:-<unset>} transferMode=${NIMBUS_TRANSFER_MODE:-redirect}"
if [ -z "${NIMBUS_SHARED_SECRET:-}" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] WARNING: no registry shared secret is set, so heartbeats will be rejected. Copy the secret from the proxy or registry into this instance's Nimbus settings."
fi
